title: Fix the Support360 application icon by updating the application-level icon confi
description: Fix the Support360 application icon. The uploaded Support360 logo in Application Properties is not appearing in the runtime; the default support_agent icon is still displayed. Configure the application so the uploaded Support360 logo is used as the application icon in the runtime, navigation/header, and public site. Do not change any other functionality. Save and deploy the updated icon configuration.

todos.label: Point the application icon config at the uploaded Support360 logo instead of the default support_agent icon
